official.deadline_note: ULisboa publishes no single central scholarship deadline for international students; admission runs through the Special Admission Contest for International Students with school-level calls. Published 2026/2027 windows: Faculdade de Ciencias - 1st cycle 2 Jan-6 Feb and 6 Apr-22 May 2026; 2nd cycle 9 Mar-17 Apr and 22 Jun-17 Jul 2026; 3rd cycle 1 Jul-17 Aug and 2 Dec 2026-15 Jan 2027. Tecnico 2026/27 - four calls (2 Jan-6 Feb, 6 Apr-22 May, 6-17 Jul, 14-17 Sep 2026, the last for master's degrees only). The 2027/2028 calendar is fixed by the annual Order of the Rector.
official.application_cycle: 2026/2027 cycle; 2027/2028 dates are set by the Rector's Order (the first phase has opened on 2 January in recent years)
official.status_note: The 2026/2027 international admission round has closed for 1st and 2nd cycle programmes (last master's call closed 17 September 2026 at Tecnico); third-cycle international applications at Faculdade de Ciencias remain open until 15 January 2027. ULisboa's own merit scholarships are not applied for by incoming students - they are awarded by each school after the academic year's results are known, and the last published rectory calls (Social Merit Scholarships, 13-24 November 2023; Alumni Solidarias, 15 January-12 February 2024) are closed.
official.tuition_coverage_note: ULisboa: 'The tuition fees set by the General Council for international students are those set out in the General Council Decision and are indicated on the page for each course.' Faculdade de Ciencias 2026/2027 publishes 'First Cycle courses: annual tuition fee of 3 500.00E', 'Second Cycle courses: annual tuition fee of 3 500.00E', 'Second Cycle in Medical Physics: annual tuition fee of 7 000.00E' and 'Second Cycle in Ecological Restoration: annual tuition fee of 3 000.00E'; the same fee is charged for 1st and 2nd cycle. Tecnico publishes '1st and 2nd study cycles: 7000E/year'. The 2026/2027 fee for national students is 697E/year. The international student brochure states that 'the international student's tuition fee may be reduced to the same value as the one paid by Portuguese students'.
benefits: Merit Scholarship (Bolsas de Estudo por Merito): 'O valor da bolsa corresponde a cinco vezes o valor da retribuicao minima mensal garantida em vigor no inicio do ano letivo em que e atribuida' - a cash award equal to five times the national minimum monthly wage in force at the start of the academic year, granted regardless of household income.

Merit scholarships are shared between ULisboa's schools in proportion to enrolled students: 94 were awarded university-wide in 2022/2023 (Tecnico 20, Faculdade de Ciencias 10, Faculdade de Direito 10, Faculdade de Letras 8, ISCSP 7, ISEG 7).

Possible reduction of the international tuition fee to the amount paid by Portuguese students: 'The international student's tuition fee may be reduced to the same value as the one paid by Portuguese students. For further information, please contact the School for which you wish to apply.'

School-level prizes at ISEG: Fundacao Economicas merit scholarships for the 10 best entering students (entry grade 16+), Santander Futuro merit scholarships (40 students, entry averages of 17.5; 18.5 for MAEG), Career Partners merit scholarships (88 students, same thresholds), and two merit scholarships for the PhD in Economic and Social History 2026/2027 'covering the full cost of first-year tuition', renewable for up to three years.
Alumni ULisboa solidarity merit grants for 1st-cycle students demonstrating merit and financial difficulty: 4 grants of 700E each were awarded in 2024.

Rectory Social Merit Scholarships for students in proven economic difficulty - the 2023 call funded three master's students in education or science communication whose household income did not exceed 15 times the Social Support Index (480.43E).
eligibility: International student status: 'An international student is a student who does not have Portuguese nationality.' Excluded from the Special Admission Contest are EU/EEA nationals, family members of Portuguese or EU nationals, non-EU nationals legally resident in Portugal for more than two years by 1 January of the entry year, beneficiaries of equal-rights treaties, and special-regime applicants.

1st cycle: a qualification granting access to higher education in the country where it was awarded, or a Portuguese secondary school diploma or legally equivalent qualification; Ciências additionally requires the admission exams to have been passed in the application year or the three preceding calendar years.
2nd cycle: a 1st-cycle (bachelor's) degree certificate meeting the fixed requirements of the cycle.

ULisboa merit scholarships: enrolled in a 1st or 2nd cycle programme and 'obtained approval in all the curricular units of the curricular year with a weighted ECTS average equal to or higher than sixteen values' (Ciências published criteria; 2nd-year master's students with more than one enrolment in that year are not eligible).
SAS ULisboa social action scholarships require Portuguese nationality or, for foreigners, one of the conditions of article 5(a) of the scholarship regulation, plus enrolment at ULisboa.

Doctoral applicants apply through each school's doctoral admission process; ISEG notes applicants 'can apply for a variety of scholarships, namely FCT scholarships ... and, in some cases, ULisboa scholarships'.
requirements: Online application through the school's platform (Fenix), with all documents submitted as scanned PDF files.

Application fee paid by bank transfer and the transfer slip uploaded: Ciências 2026/2027 public notice lists an application fee of 60,00E (reference value), a registration fee of 50,00E and a deposit of 500,00E; Tecnico requires 100E within three working days of submission, non-refundable.

Identification document (passport), recent photograph, up-to-date CV, official transcripts and diploma/degree with final average, and a separate 'document specifying the type of grading scheme of the academic records'.
For September enrolment the documents must be legalised: 'the documents have to be verified and certified by the Hague Apostille, or by the Portuguese Embassy or Consulate in your country' (Tecnico).

Portuguese B1 certificate if secondary education was not taught in Portuguese (Tecnico: 'presentation of level B1. By the end of the year, the student must demonstrate that they have reached level B1'); English B1 for bachelor's programmes taught in English and, for master's applicants whose native language is not English, TOEFL iBT above 65 or IELTS above 5 (Tecnico).
Statement under oath that the applicant holds neither Portuguese nationality nor that of an EU member state (Tecnico international students).
documents: Official academic transcript of secondary education (1st cycle) or of the bachelor's degree (2nd cycle) with final average
Diploma or certificate granting access to higher education
Document specifying the grading scheme of the academic records
Bank transfer slip for the application fee; copy of CPF for Brazilian 1st-cycle candidates (Tecnico)
selection_criteria: Merit scholarships: students ordered by their weighted ECTS average, with tie-breaks on entry grade (1st year of a bachelor's), final grade of the previous degree (1st year of a master's) or total ECTS approved in the previous year.

Merit scholarship quotas follow enrolment: 'According to the number of students enrolled ... in 1st and 2nd cycle courses in the 2022/2023 academic year, a total of 94 merit scholarships were awarded, distributed proportionally among the Schools.'
International admission: ranking on the entry qualification and on the vacancies (numerus clausus) published per programme, in each call of the Special Admission Contest.

School prizes: ISEG Santander Futuro and Career Partners merit scholarships require a 17.5 entry average (18.5 for MAEG) and ISEG as first option; EY and Caixa Geral de Depositos prizes target specific programmes and ranks.
coverage: ULisboa publishes the merit scholarship as a fixed cash amount (five times the national minimum monthly wage); the university does not state that it covers tuition or living costs.

International tuition is a cost rather than a benefit: 3 500,00E per year at Faculdade de Ciencias (7 000,00E Medical Physics; 3 000,00E Ecological Restoration), 7000E per year at Tecnico, and 4 100E to 8 000E for the first year of ISEG master's programmes for students outside the European Union (3 000E to 3 900E for the second year).
The only published fee relief is discretionary: 'The international student's tuition fee may be reduced to the same value as the one paid by Portuguese students.'

Exceptions at school level: the ISEG PhD in Economic and Social History awards two merit scholarships 'covering the full cost of first-year tuition', renewable for up to three years; the Otelinda and Carlos Silveira merit prize corresponds to the value of tuition fees for the best ISEG graduates continuing to a master's.
application_method: Apply online through the school's Fenix platform inside the Special Admission Contest for International Students window.
Pay the application fee by bank transfer within the stated deadline and upload the slip with the remaining documents.

When results are posted, reserve the vacancy with the deposit (Ciências 500,00E, 'value will be reversed into tuition'; Tecnico 2000E, corresponding to the first two tuition instalments and non-refundable) and register in the enrolment period.
For ULisboa's own merit scholarships there is no applicant submission: each school ranks enrolled students after the academic year's results and publishes the award and definitive lists.
official.application_route: Online via the school's Fenix platform during the Special Admission Contest for International Students; ULisboa's own merit awards are assigned by each school after the year's results, with no applicant submission.
official.study_mode: Full-time; ULisboa's international brochure also lists after-work programmes (for example European Studies at FL) and evening PhD lectures at ISEG
official.citizenship_residency: Open to students without Portuguese nationality; EU/EEA nationals, their family members, non-EU nationals resident in Portugal for more than two uninterrupted years by 1 January of the entry year, and equal-rights treaty beneficiaries are excluded from the international contest
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the contest exists specifically for international (non-Portuguese, non-EU) students; EU/EEA nationals apply through the National Contest instead
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No field restriction at university level; several school prizes are field-specific (ISEG economics, management and finance awards; the Economic and Social History PhD merit scholarships; the Social Merit Scholarships limited to master's degrees in education or science communication for science graduates)
official.research_requirement: No research proposal is required for the 1st and 2nd cycles; doctoral applicants apply through each school's own doctoral admission and the FCT or ULisboa fellowships are tied to a research project
official.duration: Varies by programme: the international brochure lists semester counts per programme (for example 6 semesters for a Licenciatura, 10 for architecture); ISEG lists its PhD duration as '3 to 6 years'
official.description: ULisboa is a public, federated university whose 18 schools admit international applicants through the Special Admission Contest for International Students, charging an annual international tuition fee set by the General Council. Its own financial support is a merit scholarship for already-enrolled students, worth five times the national minimum monthly wage and distributed to the schools in proportion to enrolment, while the larger sums sit in school-level prizes, sponsored scholarships and doctoral fellowships.
official.program_type: Institutional merit scholarship (cash award) plus school-level tuition and sponsored prizes, attached to international admission and the international tuition fee
official.english_requirement: No university-wide English requirement is published. Tecnico requires 'Certificate of English language proficiency (B1 level) for Bachelor's degree programs taught in English' and, for master's applicants whose native language is not English, 'TOEFL iBT (score above 65) or IELTS (score above 5)'; ISEG states that all candidates 'should have an excellent command of the English language, written and spoken' and treats the English diploma as optional

not_confirmed: A single central scholarship deadline for international applicants - ULisboa publishes only school-level application windows
A fixed euro figure for the 2026/2027 merit scholarship - ULisboa publishes the formula (five times the national minimum monthly wage) rather than an amount

Whether the five-times-minimum-wage formula still applies unchanged after Decreto-Lei 148/2026 of 20 July and Despacho 10328/2026 of 19 August moved merit scholarships into each institution's own autonomy
Which individual schools actually reduce the international fee to the national 697E rate
verification.notes: www.ulisboa.pt rectory pages refused direct retrieval (HTTP 403 across five attempts with two tools), so rectory wording was taken from the awarding body's own indexed page text and cross-checked against ULisboa faculty domains that do render: ciencias.ulisboa.pt, tecnico.ulisboa.pt and iseg.ulisboa.pt. The 4600E figure is not printed by ULisboa: it is 5 x 920E, the national minimum monthly wage for 2026 published by DGERT, applied to ULisboa's own published formula.

applicant_utility.summary: ULisboa does not hand international applicants a scholarship at the door: you enter through the Special Admission Contest, pay the international tuition fee (about 3,500E a year at Faculdade de Ciencias, 7,000E at Tecnico, up to 8,000E for ISEG master's first years) and only become eligible for the university's own money once you already hold a ULisboa transcript. The flagship institutional award is the merit scholarship, worth five times the national minimum monthly wage - 920E in 2026, so 4,600E for the academic year - which each school gives to enrolled students who passed every curricular unit with a weighted ECTS average of at least 16. The real money sits at school level: ISEG alone advertises sponsored merit scholarships for 128 entering students and two PhD awards covering full first-year tuition. Plan to fund your own living costs, because ULisboa's means-tested grants are limited to students with Portuguese nationality or the regulation's article 5(a) conditions.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Self-funded or externally funded applicants with a 16/20 academic record who want a Portuguese public university at master's or PhD level and can front the international fee until a merit award materialises.
application_readiness_checklist: Work from the school's own international notice, not the central page: ULisboa's 18 schools set their own windows, documents and fees (Ciências application fee 60E, Tecnico 100E; deposits of 500E and 2,000E).
Get transcripts and diplomas legalised early - Tecnico requires Hague Apostille or Portuguese consular certification for the September enrolment.
Book TOEFL or IELTS before the master's window opens; Tecnico publishes iBT above 65 or IELTS above 5 and will not read a motivation letter as an alternative.
Reserve the deposit money in advance (Ciências 500E reversed into tuition, Tecnico 2,000E as the first two instalments) - it is non-refundable and time-limited after results.

Email the school admissions office (for example ua@ciencias.ulisboa.pt or candidatura-pg@ciencias.ulisboa.pt) and ask directly whether your programme's international fee can be cut to the national 697E rate.
common_rejection_risks: Stale admission exams: Ciências requires the entry exams to have been passed in the application year or the three calendar years before it, so a five-year-old certificate is discarded.
Documents that are unlegalised, untranslated or missing the separate grading-scheme key.
Applying through the international contest while holding EU nationality or more than two years of Portuguese residence - the application is void.
Late or missed application fee: Tecnico demands payment within three working days of submission and does not refund it.
Assuming a sponsored prize is automatic: the ISEG Santander and Career Partners awards need a 17.5 entry average (18.5 for MAEG) and ISEG as first choice.
For merit awards, a single failed curricular unit removes eligibility even with a high average, and second-year master's students with a repeat enrolment are excluded.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition itself (3,000E-8,000E per year depending on school and programme), Lisbon living costs, the 60E-100E application fee, the non-refundable 500E-2,000E vacancy reservation, legalisation and translation costs, and flights. The published supports are a possible reduction to the national fee, a discretionary school decision, and merit prizes awarded only after enrolment.
document_audit: The passport scan is mandatory; a national ID card is not accepted in its place.
'Document specifying the type of grading scheme' is a separate file - a transcript on its own leaves the application incomplete.
Brazilian 1st-cycle candidates must add a CPF copy (Tecnico).
A Portuguese B1 certificate is needed if secondary schooling was not in Portuguese, and if you enrol without it you must still reach B1 by the end of the year.
The motivation letter is optional at Tecnico but officially listed; treat it as free space to explain a borderline transcript.
Keep the bank transfer slip for the application fee - it is itself a required upload.
alerts: The windows are short and staggered: Tecnico's 2026/27 first call ran 2 January-6 February 2026 and the fourth, master's-only call closed on 17 September 2026, so a three-day delay costs a full year.
The international fee is not the national fee - 697E a year for national students against 3,500E-7,000E for internationals, with any reduction granted case by case by the school.
Merit awards are retroactive to enrolment, so first-year international students should not budget on the 4,600E award.
Decreto-Lei 148/2026 and Despacho 10328/2026 moved merit scholarships into institutional autonomy during 2026; re-check the new school rules before relying on the five-times-minimum-wage formula.
Doctoral applicants should treat FCT fellowships, not ULisboa prizes, as the primary funding route - ISEG points applicants to FCT and to its research centres.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Open the application on the school's Fenix platform inside the contest window, upload the PDF document set, pay the application fee within three working days, then secure the place with the deposit when the results are posted.
